headline: Capacity expansion & product premiumisation to drive earning growth

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : GEE Limited reported consolidated revenue growth of 18.6% YoY to ₹101.3 crore in Q2FY27 compared to ₹85.5 crore in Q2FY26.
Gross margin contracted marginally by 39 bps YoY to 26.3% from 26.7%.
However, operating EBITDA declined 11.9% YoY to ₹7.9 crore from ₹9.0 crore, with operating EBITDA margin contracting sharply by 271 bps to 7.8% from 10.5%.
The disproportionate increase in employee expenses (+30.7% YoY) and other expenses (+37.9% YoY), both outpacing revenue growth, weighed on operating profitability.
valuation: The company plans to increase its installed capacity from around 59,000 MT to 71,000 MT, with utilisation targeted at over 90% by FY29–30.

Management targets 25–30% annual revenue growth and revenue of ₹1,000 crore by FY30, while targeting EBITDA margins of 12–13% over the next 3–4 years, driven by product-mix improvement, pricing premium and operating leverage.
Rating and Target Price : We expect Revenue and PAT to grow at 29% and 66% CAGR over FY26 - FY28E .
